title: "Copy time to clipboard" feature doesn't copy the exact current time when using C locale
line: The Digital Clock's Copy to Clipboard menu now shows and copies the real seconds instead of :00.
explanation: When the clock was set not to show seconds, ClipboardMenu replaced the current time with hh:mm:00 before formatting the entries. Entries that still include seconds (the long time format, and in the C locale also the short one) then showed and copied a time with the seconds zeroed. The change drops that zeroing and formats the real current time; formats without seconds are unaffected.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: Don't zero the seconds in Copy to Clipboard

When the clock hid seconds, the menu set them to 0 by hand, so entries
that show seconds anyway (the long time format, also the C locale's
short one) showed and copied a wrong time. Use the current time as is.

BUG: 468771

media.caption: LC_TIME=C, seconds hidden: at 16:45:22 the menu offers 16:45:00 CET
Same setup with the fix: the menu offers 16:47:10 CET, the real time
